text.lead:
The Accompanist is a 2026 American drama film co-written and directed by Zach Woods. It stars Susan Sarandon, Everly Carganilla, Aubrey Plaza, Ilia Volok, John Rothman, Helena Howard, and Kevyn Morrow.
The film premiered at the Tribeca Festival on June 4, 2026.
text.plot: 70-year-old Sylvia becomes an unlikely foster parent to 8-year-old Emily, removed from her dementia-stricken grandfather's care after a near-fatal incident in New Jersey.
text.cast:
- Susan Sarandon as Sylvia
- Everly Carganilla as Emily
- Aubrey Plaza as Sarah
- Ilia Volok as Alyosha
- John Rothman as Oscar
- Helena Howard as Wanda
- Kevyn Morrow as Martin Molido
text.production: Principal photography began on October 12, 2024, and wrapped on November 17, in New Jersey, on a drama film co-written and directed by Zach Woods. In May 2025, it was reported that Susan Sarandon, Everly Carganilla, Aubrey Plaza, Ilia Volok, John Rothman, Helena Howard, and Kevyn Morrow rounded out the cast.
text.release: The Accompanist premiered at the Tribeca Festival on June 4, 2026.
